leases.termsIntro: By signing this lease agreement, you ("The Student") agree to the following conditions regarding your occupancy at Sakny University Housing:
leases.term1: The Student shall pay all housing fees and meal plan charges on or before the specified due dates.
leases.term2: The Student agrees to abide by all university housing rules, including noise ordinances and guest policies.
leases.term3: Sakny Housing reserves the right to terminate this lease in the event of disciplinary action or failure to pay dues.
leases.term4: The Student is responsible for maintaining the room in good condition. Damages will be billed to the Student's account.
leases.termsNote: Note: This is a digital representation of the contract. The official document can be downloaded via the icon above.
